title: Chinese Face Solo #29 (중국 · 20대 · 혀 내밀기(발랄) · 메이크업 구풍(포인트) · 피어싱 P25+쥬얼리 · 혀 검은 분리된 혀 + 송곳니)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Chinese woman — Chinese fresh natural beauty luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, mid 20s, hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, sleek black long hair with a centre part. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, slender upswept willow-leaf brows, a fine red floral huadian mark painted on the forehead, softly flushed rosy cheeks, an upswept eyeliner tail, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a small vivid red lip, wide bright eyes, cheeks lifted by a cheeky grin, mouth open with her tongue stuck out straight over the lower lip, the tongue dyed jet-black and deeply forked like a snake's, split down the middle for most of its length, the two pointed tips clearly separated and curling slightly apart, two sharp pointed vampire fangs showing, a playful, mischievous expression — a photograph of a real Chinese woman's face (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light 

Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight pieces — a big copper segment ring in the lobe, three smaller copper rings above it, two thick copper bars and two small copper studs up to the top; one small copper stud sits in the right ear; four copper pieces in a row along the outer half of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two small copper rings pass through the left nostril and a thick copper septum ring hangs below the nose; a copper hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a copper snake-bite ring beside it and a small copper ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a copper Medusa stud sits above the lips; a copper labret stud and a small copper ring sit on the chin; three small copper studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small mixed gemstones (diamond, pearl, opal, amethyst, ruby and sapphire) set into alternating pieces. All jewelry is real copper, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Jewelry: besides the piercings she wears seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of gold necklaces and chains resting on her neck and collarbones, and seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of gold hair ornaments set in her hair, all of it real, without covering her eyes, her face or her piercings.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
